description: This PHP class, CreateModuleParams, extends BaseParam and appears to be part of an API parameter handling layer. It defines methods to get data parameters, and configures validation and normalization rules for the 'data' parameter using Symfony's OptionsResolver and Validator components. The class encapsulates parameter configuration logic related to creating a module in the application.

classes.name: CreateModuleParams
classes.description: A PHP class used to define and configure parameters for creating a module, including setting validation rules and normalizing input data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the 'data' parameter from the class's parameters array.

methods.description: Configures validation and normalization for the 'data' parameter using Symfony's OptionsResolver.
